newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends lower despite BOK interventions.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends lower despite BOK interventions.

text.p: Large dollar purchases by the government's Office of Supply sent the won sliding against the U.S. unit on Friday despite active dollar selling by the central Bank of Korea, dealers said.
The won ended at low of 844.80, against an opening of 844.40. It touched a high of 843.60.
The Office of Supply purchased about $40 million late in the day to meet procurement needs, one European dealer estimated.
Dealers said the won would continue to stay under pressure because of heavy importer settlements next week.
